title: Current product already has meaningful commercial value
statement: Mesa, Prospecção, Call AI, Comunicação, Sales Brain, ROI/quotation and Excel-related workflows are assets to preserve rather than reasons for a full rewrite.
evidence_summary: Audit/plan identify existing commercial modules as assets to preserve.

title: Foundation reliability was the primary structural gap
statement: The primary gap was not feature count but reliable source of truth, canonical identity, individual identity, synchronization/conflict, restore/backup, observability and critical tests.
evidence_summary: Audit and gap analysis converge on foundation reliability as primary structural gap.

title: Package 01 left canonical data and auth disabled
statement: Package 01 was additive; canonical data and authentication paths remain disabled by default and commercial data was not migrated.
evidence_summary: Package 01 report confirms feature flags leave canonical/auth paths disabled by default.

title: Commercial guidance context has explicit invalidation boundaries
statement: Next-action dependent context must be invalidated when the action meaning changes, terminal/no-action states must not fabricate a next step, and cached commercial guidance must vary with every relevant context field.
evidence_summary: CIC-01 final audit fixes showed stale reason/objective/result after action changes, unsafe fallback actions in terminal states, and cache sensitivity as concrete cross-surface correctness concerns.

title: V3 and core are one product with different migration roles
statement: The brownfield core retains mature engines while preview-v2 provides the V3 experience; the intended state is one user experience with internal reuse, not two independent products or CRMs.
evidence_summary: Repository and runtime audit show apps/sistema-og as mature core, preview-v2 as V3 shell, quote handoff/embedded legacy bridge, and shared services between them.

title: Shared OG technical engine exists but unification is incomplete
statement: technical-application-core-v3.js exposes resolveVehicleSupports, buildConsolidatedVehiclePieces and positionSupports and is covered by parity tests, while remaining fallback logic means single-engine convergence is not yet complete.
evidence_summary: Current branch contains the extracted engine, V3 quote service consumption and test-technical-parity.mjs; technical handoff marks fallback removal as pending.

title: AI-derived CRM changes pass through Review Gate
statement: Research and Call Intelligence suggestions are not persisted as customer facts until a user reviews approved fields/notes through the V3 Review Gate.
evidence_summary: preview-v2/review-gate-v3.js creates REVIEW_REQUIRED suggestions and commits only explicitly approved profile, interaction or call fields.

title: DUTRA knowledge is routed rather than globally loaded
statement: Project intelligence uses the existing Second Brain as durable evidence plus compact domain Skills and a task router, while dynamic account data remains in runtime CRM storage.
evidence_summary: Intelligence Compiler V1 adds docs/intelligence routing and domain skills without creating a separate knowledge database.
